data.long_meaning: Mastram is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'mas' which means 'mind'. The name Mastram refers to the one who is the lord or controller of the mind. It is believed that one who carries this name possesses the power to control their thoughts and emotions. The name Mastram carries the meaning “Lord of the mind” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mastram usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the mind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
